title: Expectation Preference Optimization: Reliable Preference Estimation for Improving the Reasoning Capability of Large Language Models
paper_type_zh: 面向推理自训练的组级偏好估计研究
best_for_zh: 从每个提示的多次可验证推理采样构造偏好数据的读者。
one_line: EPO learns from groups of correct and incorrect sampled responses, estimating a group expectation rather than trusting one preference pair.
EPO 从成组的正确与错误采样回答中学习，以组期望估计取代对单个偏好对的信任。
why: It makes multi-sample grouping and within-group probability weighting part of the training signal rather than using one arbitrary response pair.
inclusion_reason: It changes a preference record from one chosen/rejected pair into probability-weighted groups of correct and incorrect sampled responses.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Direct Preference Optimization usually constructs one preferred and one dispreferred response for each prompt. For reasoning, a single correct-versus-incorrect pair can be a poor estimate of the true learning direction: answers can fail for different reasons, a sampled correct answer can be atypical, and one pair can place probability mass on misleading local patterns. Adding new external labels or rewriting the loss is often proposed to mitigate this uncertainty.

The paper asks whether the preference record itself can be made more reliable by observing multiple responses before training. It replaces a single pair with a preferred group and a dispreferred group, then compares their expected rewards. In the self-training setting, correctness partitions sampled rationales into the two groups, allowing a verifiable final answer to create richer preference supervision without requiring a separate human annotation for every rollout.

直接偏好优化通常为每条提示构造一个入选回答和一个拒绝回答。对于推理任务，单个正确、错误回答对可能是对真实学习方向的较差估计：回答可能因不同原因失败，采样到的正确答案可能并不典型，而一个样本对可能把概率质量放到误导性的局部模式上。人们常通过增加新的外部标签或改写损失来缓解这种不确定性。

论文要回答的是：能否在训练前观察多个回答，从而使偏好记录本身更可靠。它用一个入选回答组和一个拒绝回答组替代单一回答对，然后比较它们的期望奖励。在自训练设置中，正确性将采样的推理过程划分为两个组，使可验证的最终答案可以生成更丰富的偏好监督，而无需为每条 rollout 单独获取人工标注。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
EPO interprets the reward of a response group as the expectation of the rewards of its members. Rather than deciding that one sampled correct rationale is the whole preferred signal, it asks whether the preferred group has higher expected reward than the dispreferred group. Each response's contribution is weighted by its reference-model probability, so a response that is more likely under the sampling reference affects the optimization direction more strongly.

This turns multi-sampling into an explicit data-construction decision. The model first generates several candidate answers for the same question; correctness places them in groups; EPO consumes the group statistics rather than collapsing them to one arbitrary pair. When both groups contain one response, the objective reduces to ordinary DPO. The paper therefore frames DPO as a limiting case of a broader record that retains uncertainty and variation among sampled solutions.

EPO 将一个回答组的奖励解释为其成员奖励的期望。它不再认定一个采样到的正确推理过程就是全部入选信号，而是询问入选组是否具有高于拒绝组的期望奖励。每个回答的贡献由其参考模型概率加权，因此在采样参考下更可能出现的回答，对优化方向的影响更强。

这使多次采样成为一项明确的数据构造决策。模型先针对同一个问题生成若干候选答案；正确性将它们放入不同组；EPO 消费组统计量，而不是把它们压缩为一个任意回答对。当两个组都只含一个回答时，该目标退化为普通 DPO。因此，论文将 DPO 视为一个更广泛记录的极限情形，后者保留了采样解之间的不确定性和差异。

title: Method
方法
html:
After supervised fine-tuning, the model samples 20 responses per training query at temperature 0.7 and adds the original rationale to the candidate pool. A rule-based verifier checks each final answer. Candidates matching the target answer enter the preferred group, and the others enter the dispreferred group. Prompts with no incorrect sampled answer are discarded because they cannot form both groups. The group-level data record retains all of these responses rather than choosing one winner and one loser.

EPO calculates a probability-weighted mean of policy/reference log ratios inside each group and applies a logistic loss to the difference between preferred and dispreferred expectations. A smoothing coefficient controls instability caused by incomplete probability sums. The method may truncate responses in both groups to a fixed length, because the authors find that late tokens can destabilize optimization. It is evaluated after SFT on arithmetic and commonsense reasoning datasets against RFT, DPO, batched DPO, RPO, and Step-DPO.

监督微调后，模型以 0.7 的温度针对每条训练问题采样 20 个回答，并将原始推理过程加入候选池。基于规则的验证器检查每个最终答案。与目标答案一致的候选回答进入入选组，其余回答进入拒绝组。没有采到任何错误答案的提示会被丢弃，因为它们无法形成两个组。组级数据记录保留所有这些回答，而不是选择一个胜者和一个败者。

EPO 计算每个组内策略、参考模型对数比的概率加权均值，并将入选和拒绝期望之间的差异用于逻辑损失。一个平滑系数控制不完整概率和造成的不稳定性。该方法可以将两个组中的回答截断到固定长度，因为作者发现后面的 token 可能使优化不稳定。它在算术和常识推理数据集上，于 SFT 后与 RFT、DPO、批量 DPO、RPO 和 Step-DPO 进行比较。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The reported results show gains across arithmetic and commonsense reasoning settings. For Llama-2-13B, EPO improves accuracy over SFT by 5.43 percentage points on GSM8K and 3.29 on the MetaMath subset; for Qwen2.5-7B, the corresponding improvements are 2.64 and 2.05. The paper also reports increases of 3.58 on SocialIQA for Llama-3-8B, 4.47 on ARC-Easy for Mistral-7B, 6.94 on ARC-Challenge for Llama-2-13B, and 6.29 on MathQA for Mistral-7B.

Several analyses test the construction choices. The study finds that EPO consistently exceeds the listed preference-optimization baselines across its tasks, while ordinary DPO can damage performance in some mathematical settings. It reports that longer group-response limits generally improve estimation until a limit below 20 harms performance, and that response sampling distribution matters: selecting groups from high-probability correct and low-probability incorrect responses is not equivalent to random construction. A false-positive analysis finds roughly 3.52 to 6.00 percent of positive samples may be mislabeled as sample count rises.

报告结果显示，该方法在算术和常识推理设置中均有提升。对于 Llama-2-13B，EPO 相对 SFT 在 GSM8K 上的准确率提升 5.43 个百分点，在 MetaMath 子集上提升 3.29 个百分点；对于 Qwen2.5-7B，对应提升为 2.64 和 2.05 个百分点。论文还报告，Llama-3-8B 在 SocialIQA 上提升 3.58 个百分点，Mistral-7B 在 ARC-Easy 上提升 4.47 个百分点，Llama-2-13B 在 ARC-Challenge 上提升 6.94 个百分点，Mistral-7B 在 MathQA 上提升 6.29 个百分点。

多项分析检验了数据构造选择。研究发现，EPO 在其全部任务上稳定超过列出的偏好优化基线，而普通 DPO 在一些数学设置中可能损害性能。它报告，更长的组回答长度限制通常改善估计，但低于 20 的限制会损害表现；回答采样分布也很重要：从高概率正确和低概率错误回答中选择组，并不等价于随机构造。一个假阳性分析发现，随着样本数上升，大约 3.52% 至 6.00% 的正样本可能被错误标注。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The central novelty is to elevate a collection of rollouts to the unit of preference supervision. Prior pairwise methods decide a learning direction from two individual responses. EPO instead preserves multiple correct and incorrect trajectories, computes a weighted group expectation, and sends that aggregate to the loss. This changes the training record itself: the response label is no longer a binary edge between two texts but a structured partition of a prompt's sampled behavior.

The approach also links a simple verifiable answer signal to a richer reward estimate. Correctness is not claimed to describe every quality of a reasoning trace; it supplies a partition from which EPO estimates a less sample-sensitive direction. The optional length limitation is another explicit decision about which part of each grouped trace enters training. Together, grouping, probability weighting, and truncation define a training consumer distinct from merely increasing DPO batch size.

核心新意是将一组 rollout 提升为偏好监督的单位。以往的成对方法从两个单独回答决定学习方向。EPO 则保留多个正确和错误轨迹，计算加权的组期望，并将该聚合量送入损失。这改变了训练记录本身：回答标签不再是两段文本之间的二元边，而是对一个提示的采样行为进行结构化划分。

该方法还将简单的可验证答案信号连接到更丰富的奖励估计。正确性并未被声称可以描述推理过程的每一种质量；它提供一种划分，EPO 从中估计对单一样本不那么敏感的方向。可选的长度限制是关于每条分组轨迹哪些部分进入训练的另一项明确决策。分组、概率加权和截断共同定义了不同于单纯增加 DPO 批量大小的训练消费者。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The demonstrated construction relies on tasks with binary verifiable answers, and the authors do not provide a method for calculating comparable group expectations in subjective alignment settings. Rule-based answer checks create false positives and the rate grows somewhat as more candidates are sampled. The choice of response length limit, sample count, smoothing, and group sampling distribution can change the resulting signal. Evidence is limited to the reported open models and datasets, and the authors note non-commercial restrictions for the models they use.
文中展示的数据构造依赖具有二元可验证答案的任务，作者没有提供在主观对齐设置中计算可比较组期望的方法。基于规则的答案检查会产生假阳性，并且随着采样候选变多，该比例会略有增长。回答长度限制、样本数、平滑系数和组采样分布的选择都会改变最终信号。证据局限于报告中的开放模型和数据集，作者还指出其使用的模型存在非商业限制。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: EPO is useful when a system can cheaply obtain multiple rollouts and validate their terminal answers, but a single chosen/rejected pair is too brittle to represent the learning opportunity. It provides a specific schema for preserving all correct and incorrect candidates and a recipe for converting that schema into a preference objective. Before reuse, teams should audit verifier error, define how duplicates and all-correct/all-wrong prompts are handled, test sample counts and truncation, and confirm that the task's terminal answer genuinely captures the behavior they want to optimize.
当系统能够低成本获得多个 rollout 并验证其终止答案，但单个入选、拒绝回答对过于脆弱、无法表示学习机会时，EPO 很有用。它提供保留全部正确和错误候选的具体结构，以及将该结构转化为偏好目标的方案。在复用之前，团队应审计验证器错误，定义如何处理重复、全对和全错提示，测试样本数和截断，并确认任务的终止答案确实捕捉到希望优化的行为。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read Equation 9 after the group construction in Section 3.3: the key record is not just a larger DPO minibatch, but a prompt-specific partition whose members are probability weighted. Then inspect the length-limit and sampling-distribution analyses, because those determine which portions and which kinds of rollouts dominate the expectation. For implementation, log the generator checkpoint, temperature, number of samples, verifier normalization, original-rationale inclusion, group-drop rule, gamma, and truncation threshold; each is part of the constructed supervision rather than incidental preprocessing.
应在第 3.3 节的组构造之后阅读公式 9：关键记录不只是一个更大的 DPO 小批量，而是一个成员按概率加权的、提示专属的划分。随后查看长度限制和采样分布分析，因为它们决定哪些部分、哪些类型的 rollout 主导期望。对于实现，应记录生成器检查点、温度、采样数、验证器规范化、原始推理过程是否加入、丢组规则、gamma 和截断阈值；这些都是构造出的监督的一部分，而不是无关的预处理。

Self-improving preference optimization on tasks with programmatically checkable final answers.

Llama-3-8B, Llama-2-13B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Mistral-7B.
Original task rationales and programmatic correctness labels; Yi-Chat-34B creates some ARC and SocialIQA SFT rationales.
Sample 20 responses per prompt from the SFT model at temperature 0.7, then group by final-answer correctness.
Construct group pairs after SFT, include the original rationale in each candidate pool, and train preference methods for three epochs.
Discard a prompt when sampled responses contain no incorrect answer; optionally truncate all group responses to a preset maximum length.
Generation and preference training use 16 A100 80GB GPUs in the reported experiments; no separate cost estimate is stated.
Expectation Preference Optimization, which weights response log-ratios by reference probabilities within each group.

No dedicated contamination audit is reported; released-task and evaluation overlap should be independently checked.
